abs_instant.rationale: single time sample; the initial spurious pressure has not decayed

abs_plateau_avg.rationale: m2971 canonical: plateau mean over a time-averaged window

abs_tail_avg.rationale: m2971 canonical: absolute pressure, plateau-segment time average

bandA_instant.rationale: upper band sits in the surface density-deficit layer: biases dp low

bandB_instant.rationale: wider version of bandA; same density-deficit contamination

band_ensemble_instant.rationale: ensemble over lattice phase at fixed t = 1 t_sigma; still an instant

center_minus_band_instant.rationale: band pressure can be exactly 0 (degenerate), so the reading silently becomes absolute

center_minus_band_relax.rationale: relaxed form of center_minus_band_instant; band location drifts with dx

cut_force_half.rationale: half-domain cut force, not a pressure difference (auxiliary quantity)

legacy_gradient_instant.rationale: pre-CSF colour gradient; kept only as a regression floor

legacy_status_quo.rationale: pre-CSF status-quo probe, superseded by the consistent scheme

one_sided_free_surface.rationale: one-sided kernel truncation at the free surface

shell_band_relax.rationale: m277/m2174 convention; the shell band sits inside the interface

two_phase_abs_instant.rationale: both sides wetted, so no free-surface closure is exercised; still a single instant

two_phase_sharp_instant.rationale: as two_phase_abs_instant, but with an under-resolved colour step

note: numbers are extracted from the listed artefacts at build time; never hand copied

out_of_scope.reason: droplet oscillation frequency, not a pressure jump (quantity = omega)
free-surface flow validation, no Laplace reference value
curvature and cut force at t=0 only via a different operator chain; its relaxed dp entry is in scope, the instant curvature rows are not

sigma0_rdx5.question: sigma -> 0 control: is the reading surface-tension generated?

sigma7_rdx10.question: same code path and time, one refinement step (R/dx = 10)

purpose: single machine-checked register of every Laplace-jump reading committed in benchmarks/, tagged by measurement convention

readings.note: p_interface_band is 0.0 here, so the reading degenerates to absolute

cut_force_ratio.label: half-domain cut force ratio F_cut/(2 sigma L)
